mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PROVEEDOR_LINEA_COMERCIAL( id_proveedor_linea_comercial, id_familia , id_linea_comercial , id_proveedor , id_subfamilia , otros_linea_comercial ) VALUES( (select cast(COALESCE(MAX(id_proveedor_linea_comercial), 0) as integer) + 1 as newId from PROVEEDOR_LINEA_COMERCIAL) , #{familia}, #{lineaComercial}, #{proveedor}, #{subFamilia}, #{otrosLineaComercial} )
mapper.update: UPDATE PROVEEDOR_LINEA_COMERCIAL SET ID_FAMILIA = #{familia}, ID_LINEA_COMERCIAL = #{lineaComercial}, OTROS_LINEA_COMERCIAL = #{otrosLineaComercial} WHERE ID_PROVEEDOR_LINEA_COMERCIAL = #{idProveedorLineaComercial}
mapper.select: SELECT pv.acreedor_codigo_sap AS codigo_sap, pv.ruc, pv.razon_social, linea.descripcion AS linea, ( SELECT lc.descripcion FROM LINEA_COMERCIAL lc WHERE lc.ID_LINEA_COMERCIAL = plc.ID_FAMILIA) AS familia, ( SELECT lc.descripcion FROM LINEA_COMERCIAL lc WHERE lc.ID_LINEA_COMERCIAL = plc.ID_FAMILIA) AS subfamilia, plc.otros_linea_comercial FROM PROVEEDOR_LINEA_COMERCIAL plc INNER JOIN PROVEEDOR pv ON plc.id_proveedor = pv.id_proveedor INNER JOIN LINEA_COMERCIAL linea ON plc.id_linea_comercial = linea.id_linea_comercial ORDER BY pv.razon_social;
